Missing keywords in NSISLexer and Changed-By field in DebianControlLexer

I'm having issues with the lexers in the installers module. There seem to be two separate problems:

1. In the NSISLexer, the 'true' keyword is not being recognized as a constant. This causes highlighting issues in my NSIS scripts where 'true' is not properly colored like other constants.

```nsis
Section "Example"
  SetOutPath "$INSTDIR"
  DetailPrint "This is a test"
  StrCmp $0 "true" 0 +2
  MessageBox MB_OK "Value is true"
SectionEnd
```

In the above example, "true" should be highlighted as a constant like other keywords such as "force", "hide", etc.

2. In the DebianControlLexer, the 'Changed-By' field is not being recognized properly. When I have a debian/control file with this field, it's not highlighted correctly:

```
Source: mypackage
Section: utils
Priority: optional
Maintainer: John Doe <john@example.com>
Changed-By: Jane Smith <jane@example.com>
Build-Depends: debhelper (>= 11)
Standards-Version: 4.1.3
```

The 'Changed-By' field should be highlighted the same way as 'Maintainer' and 'Uploaders'.

I checked the code and it looks like 'true' is missing from the Name.Constant list in NSISLexer, and 'Changed-By' is missing from the keyword list in DebianControlLexer.

Scope of this editing session: update the following production files and report the resulting local change for handover: pygments/lexers/installers.py. No full task validation has been performed in this session.

{"status": "ok", "filepath": "pygments/lexers/installers.py", "content": "class DebianControlLexer(RegexLexer):
    """
    Lexer for Debian ``control`` files and ``apt-cache show <pkg>`` outputs.
    """
    name = 'Debian Control file'
    url = 'https://www.debian.org/doc/debian-policy/ch-controlfields.html'
    aliases = ['debcontrol', 'control']
    filenames = ['control']
    version_added = '0.9'

    tokens = {
        'root': [
            (r'^(Description)', Keyword, 'description'),
            (r'^(Maintainer|Uploaders)(:)(\s*)',
             bygroups(Keyword, Punctuation, Whitespace),
             'maintainer'),
            (r'^((?:Build-|Pre-)?Depends(?:-Indep|-Arch)?)(:)(\s*)',
             bygroups(Keyword, Punctuation, Whitespace), 'package_list'),
            (r'^(Recommends|Suggests|Enhances|Breaks|Replaces|Provides|Conflicts)(:)(\s*)',
             bygroups(Keyword, Punctuation, Whitespace), 'package_list'),
            (r'^((?:Python-)?Version)(:)(\s*)(\S+)$',
             bygroups(Keyword, Punctuation, Whitespace, Number)),
            (r'^((?:Installed-)?Size)(:)(\s*)(\S+)$',
             bygroups(Keyword, Punctuation, Whitespace, Number)),
            (r'^(MD5Sum|SHA1|SHA256)(:)(\s*)(\S+)$',
             bygroups(Keyword, Punctuation, Whitespace, Number)),
            (r'^([a-zA-Z\-0-9\.]*?)(:)(\s*)(.*?)$',
             bygroups(Keyword, Punctuation, Whitespace, String)),
        ],", "start_line": 293, "end_line": 321, "total_lines": 352, "is_truncated": false}
